title: Green-Channel CLAHE and a Mild-Weighted Threshold Objective for Cross-Dataset Diabetic Retinopathy Grading with MobileViT-S: An Exploratory Evaluation (code and metrics)
description: Code, configuration files, training logs metadata, metric tables, prediction summaries, and figure/table generation scripts accompanying an exploratory, schedule-stratified MobileViT-S study of green-channel CLAHE and a mild-weighted shared-weight threshold objective for cross-dataset diabetic retinopathy grading (APTOS-only training; external evaluation on IDRiD, Messidor-2, and DeepDRiD). Dataset images are not included. Seeds 42-44 and 45-47 are not exchangeable replicates because of a truncated versus full cosine learning-rate schedule. Threshold-head models are not rank-consistent CORAL; calibration is reported only for cross-entropy models.
notes: Do not upload restricted fundus images. Fill ORCID and the manuscript DOI after publication. APTOS partition archive SHA-256 is recorded in data_manifest/aptos_archive_hash.csv.
